description: Session feedback-report structure for PrepVista. Defines the ordered report sections shown after each mock interview, each bound to its data source and a visibility level (student / tpo / both). The report renderer reads this to build a student's feedback and the TPO's session view. Sources are cross-checked against scoring_config, categories, competencies, and interview_blueprints.

sections.label: Overall Result
sections.description: The top-line outcome: overall score (0-10), readiness tier, and the 0-100 Placement Readiness Index.

sections.label: Readiness Pillars
sections.description: Score on each of the 7 placement-readiness pillars, with the weakest highlighted.

sections.label: Category Breakdown
sections.description: Per-category score versus the 'ready' threshold, so the student sees exactly which of the 14 areas clear the bar.

sections.label: Competency Profile
sections.description: Score across the 9 canonical competencies, with notable sub-competency strengths and gaps.

sections.label: What You Did Well
sections.description: The top strengths from this session — the categories and competencies the candidate handled best.

sections.label: Where to Focus Next
sections.description: The two or three weakest areas, each with concrete, actionable coaching tips from the module.

sections.label: Question-by-Question Review
sections.description: For each question: the score, what was strong, what to improve, a model better-answer, and the follow-up asked.

sections.label: Integrity Summary
sections.description: Integrity risk band and any flags. The TPO sees the detail; the student sees only a soft note if review is suggested.

sections.label: Recommended Next Steps
sections.description: Suggested drills or blueprints to run next, chosen to target this session's weakest areas.

sections.label: Your Progress
sections.description: How this session compares with previous ones — trend in overall score, PRI, and per-pillar movement.

coaching.tone: constructive, specific, and encouraging — never harsh
coaching.note: Tips come from each module's coaching_for(); never just 'do better' — always a concrete next action.

benchmarking.privacy: aggregate only — never names other students
benchmarking.note: Helps a student see where they stand without exposing anyone else's data.

student_vs_tpo.student_sees: All sections except integrity detail; integrity surfaces only as a soft 'session flagged for review' note if applicable.
student_vs_tpo.tpo_sees: Everything, including full integrity signals and cohort analytics.
student_vs_tpo.rationale: Protect students from false-accusation framing while giving TPOs what they need.

tone_guidelines: Lead with what went well before what to improve.
Be specific: cite the question and the exact gap.
Frame weaknesses as 'next focus', not failure.
Keep it concise — a student should act on it, not drown in it.
Never compare a student to a named peer.
